title: Should we move 40 people from Slack to Microsoft Teams?
variant: Compact two-column: checklist and risks on one screen
prompt: Should I switch our 40-person company from Slack to Microsoft Teams? We already pay for Microsoft 365.
note: Compact and two-column on a wide screen, because the reader is an operations lead deciding on a laptop who wants the checklist, the risks, and the revisit conditions on one screen; the error-toned badge sits in the header's right column so the answer and the title land together. The factors are real checkboxes the reader ticks against their own case, with a small script that counts them and says when the answer flips and a page that reads the same with scripts off, and the risks are a numbered list in the sidebar above a revisit-when box, since a not-yet answer owes the reader the conditions that reopen it.
